Subtitle: One workspace for your local LLM cluster
RememberSettingsHelp: Save profile, language, theme and window on close and restore on launch. When disabled, only this switch is remembered; profiles and saved keys are neither read nor written.
TopologyDescription: The coordinator receives requests and distributes computation across local and remote GPUs.
RoleHelp: The coordinator stores the model and serves the API. Workers expose compute devices through RPC.
DiagnosticsHelp: Inspect the operating system, available processors, and NVIDIA GPUs on this computer.
FirstStageDescription: Install the same llama.cpp build on each PC, start RPC on workers, then start the coordinator. API readiness and the test request are checked separately.
AgentNotRpc: MagicOnion carries management and diagnostics. Model computation uses the separate llama.cpp RPC protocol.
NodesHelp: Start the agent on each worker first. Enter its address and separate management and compute ports. Agent connectivity does not confirm RPC readiness.
LocalAgentHelp: Configure the MagicOnion diagnostics agent. Start it here, then enter its address and token under Network nodes on another PC. Selecting a computer role does not start the agent.
AllowAgentLan: Allow connections from the local network
LocalAgentLanHelp: LAN listens on 0.0.0.0; specify an interface IP if needed. Network access requires at least 24 token characters; a blank token is generated on startup. Key persistence is controlled on Overview. TLS is enabled separately and is required for remote RPC control.
AspNetRuntimeMissing: Compatible .NET and ASP.NET Core Runtime 10 are required to start the agent. Click Download and install below
RuntimeInstallHelp: Downloads and verifies two Microsoft installers of the same stable 10.0.x version: .NET Runtime first, then ASP.NET Core Runtime. Confirm UAC prompts for both installers. Internet access is required; automatic restart is disabled. This installation button supports Windows.
RuntimeInstalling: Installing .NET dependencies. Confirm the Windows prompt…
RuntimeInstalledRetry: .NET dependencies installed. Click Start agent again
RuntimeInstalledRestart: .NET dependencies installed. The installer requested a PC restart; start the agent afterwards
RuntimeInstallCancelled: Installation cancelled. You can download and install again
RuntimeInstallFailed: Could not install .NET dependencies. Check your connection and try again
LocalAgentReady: Agent running, MagicOnion and token verified
LocalAgentExited: The agent process exited. Check settings and start it again.
LocalPortCheckOnly: A local check does not confirm access through the firewall. Run the TCP check from another PC.
TcpPortClosed: TCP connection failed: check the address, running process and firewall
TcpOnly: Only the TCP connection was tested; protocol and token were not verified
AgentFirewallHelp: Creates or updates an inbound rule for the selected agent TCP port: LocalSubnet sources and Private profile only. Windows requests administrator rights (UAC). On Linux/macOS, configure the OS firewall separately. Does not change Kaspersky or other third-party firewalls, or open compute RPC.
AgentFirewallReady: Private / LocalSubnet firewall rule configured. Test access from another PC
TokenNotSaved: Keys are excluded from the JSON profile; permitted persistence uses separate protected storage. Enable TLS and pin the certificate SHA-256 for network control.
LlamaInstallHelp: Select the same build tag on every PC and install the package. CUDA includes libraries from the same release; Windows x64 uses CUDA 12.4 and Linux x64 uses CUDA 12.8. A compatible NVIDIA driver is required. CPU can be used for testing without a GPU. New versions are installed alongside older versions; change the tag to update.
LlamaVerifying: Checking executables, build version and RPC support…
EngineControlHelp: Starts the current role: RPC on a worker or inference API on the coordinator. For LAN access set the bind address to 0.0.0.0 or an interface IP. Use RPC only on a trusted local network. Start worker RPC processes before the main server. Closing Desktop stops its engine process.
ServerApiKey: Inference API key · generated on start when empty; remembered with Keys enabled
EngineStarting: Checking build and nodes, starting engine and waiting for readiness…
RpcReady: RPC process started and local TCP port is open; the main server verifies cluster readiness
InferenceReady: Model ready: /health and authenticated /v1/models verified. Local API URL
EngineExited: Engine exited. Check its log before restarting
RpcFirewallReady: RPC rule configured: Private / LocalSubnet. Check access from the main PC
InferenceTestPassed: Generation through the OpenAI-compatible API confirmed
InvalidEngineSettings: Check GPU layer count and startup timeout
RuntimeHelp: Install a matching build above or select an existing one. CLI version and RPC are checked before launch. Only the coordinator needs a model.
ModelFile: GGUF file · required on the coordinator
ModelDirectory: Models directory · initial folder for GGUF selection
DiscoveryHelp: Searches this PC: application folders, PATH and LM Studio backends. File presence does not confirm CUDA/RPC compatibility; an LM Studio backend may contain only llama-server.
RuntimeDiscovered: Found an executable for the selected role. Choose another result below if needed; compatibility requires running the engine.
RuntimeRoleMissing: Directories were found, but the executable for the selected role is missing. A worker needs ggml-rpc-server, separately from the MagicOnion agent.
RuntimeNotDiscovered: llama.cpp was not found in known locations. Select a compatible build directory manually.
ModelsDiscovered: Models directory found. Click Browse next to the GGUF file to open it; a model is not selected automatically.
ModelsNotDiscovered: No existing models directory found. Select one manually or check downloadsFolder in LM Studio settings.
DiscoveryReadErrors: Some folders or settings could not be read; check the path manually
PreviewHelp: Preview displays arguments without executing them. Use the compute process controls to launch; the API key is passed through the environment. RPC is for trusted networks only.
ProfileLocation: The profile is stored on this computer only:
ValidationFailed: Resolve the errors before preparing a launch
PlanReady: Plan prepared · model readiness has not been checked
GpuUnavailable: NVIDIA information is unavailable. This probe does not detect other GPU vendors.
AgentConnected: Agent reachable · RPC state has not been checked
InvalidBindAddress: Enter a valid listen IP address
LanBinding: Network access requires an API key and restricted RPC access
InvalidPort: TCP ports must be between 1 and 65535
InvalidContext: Context must contain at least 512 tokens
InvalidThreads: CPU thread count must be positive
RuntimeMissing: The executable for this role was not found
InvalidNode: Check the name, address, and separate agent/RPC ports
DuplicateNode: The same RPC endpoint was added more than once
CompatibilityNotVerified: GGUF compatibility, RPC versions, and actual GPU placement require a runtime launch
GgufHeaderFound: GGUF v2/v3 signature found; tokenizer and tensors were not checked
InvalidGguf: The file does not have a supported GGUF header
ClusterLoadHelp: Each computer is shown separately. CPU is system-wide usage; GPU shows compute load and occupied VRAM. Remote measurements come from node agents.
MonitorNeedsKey: Enter the agent key in Network nodes
MonitorUpdateAgent: Update Agent to receive load data
NoGpuTelemetry: NVIDIA GPU data unavailable. Other accelerators are not queried yet.
GenerationSettingsHelp: Applied on the next engine start and saved by the shared settings switch. Max Output and sampling are server defaults; an external API client can override them per request.
ReasoningHelp: Effort is reference information: copy supported levels into your OpenAI-compatible client. The client supplies the value per request; missing or unsupported values use the template default. Reasoning: auto / on / off; budget -1 is unrestricted, 0 ends thinking.
EffortUnknown: Effort support will be checked via /props after the model is loaded.
EffortUnsupported: This model chat template does not support Effort. The Effort setting has no effect for it.
MemorySettingsHelp: Microbatch must not exceed Batch. Quantized V cache requires Flash Attention and backend support. Large contexts and parallel requests need more memory; check the engine log when tuning.
InvalidModelSettings: Check model settings: sampling ranges, batch/microbatch size, KV cache and Flash Attention.
RememberAgentKeys: Remember agent and inference API keys in protected storage
RememberAgentKeysHelp: Windows: current-user DPAPI. Unix: AES-GCM with a 0600 key file. The general setting above controls reading and writing. Turning key persistence off clears the saved keys on close when general saving is enabled. Includes the local agent key, remote node keys and the inference API key.
AllowRemoteControl: Allow the agent to start and stop RPC remotely
TlsControlHelp: Remote control requires TLS and a key of at least 24 characters. The agent starts only the runtime installed through Desktop. It cannot stop RPC owned by another Desktop or started manually. Create the separate RPC firewall rule on this computer.
PairingHelp: Copy the full certificate SHA-256 and key from the worker agent tab over a trusted channel. Pairing verifies both values; unknown certificates are never accepted automatically.
PairingRequiresTls: Enable TLS and enter the SHA-256 fingerprint and a key of at least 24 characters
GpuDistributionHelp: Start worker RPC first. The check compares builds and enumerates devices through llama.cpp. Suggestions use free memory minus a reserve and set explicit --device / --tensor-split order. These are initial proportions, not a guarantee of GGUF/KV-cache capacity or network speed. Empty fields let the engine choose.
NoClusterDevices: CLI returned no accelerators with memory measurements. CPU mode is available; automatic split is not applied.
BenchmarkHelp: Two identical short requests, up to 32 tokens each. Shows server prompt/generation timings when available and total HTTP time. Cache is not reset: the first request can also use cached input. Missing timings are shown as a dash.
ModelLoadFailed: Model loading failed or engine exited — see log
ModelProgressHelp: The stage comes from the llama.cpp log. This build does not report a weight loading percentage; readiness is confirmed through the API.
MemoryHelp: Physical system RAM: used / total. Available memory includes reclaimable OS cache. Older agents may not report RAM.
WorkloadCustomHelp: Settings are configured manually. A selected profile takes effect after Apply profile and the next engine start.
WorkloadInteractiveHelp: Context 8192, one slot, batch 512 / microbatch 128. Starting configuration for short requests.
WorkloadBalancedHelp: Context 16384, one slot, batch 512 / microbatch 128. More room for conversation history.
WorkloadThroughputHelp: Total context 16384, two slots, batch 1024 / microbatch 256. The pinned build provides 8192 tokens per slot.
WorkloadMaximumHelp: Context 131072 (128K), output up to 32768 (32K), one slot, batch 512 / microbatch 128. A full output leaves 98304 input tokens. Requires model support and sufficient memory.
WorkloadApplied: Profile applied for the next start
WorkloadLimits: Model, devices, Effort, KV cache precision and Flash Attention are preserved. Maximum context sets output to 32K; other profiles preserve the output limit. Capacity and speed depend on model and memory; this is not a RAM limit. Stop the engine before applying.
ActivityHelp: Status from /slots and llama.cpp logs refreshes with load monitoring. Generation includes reasoning and the answer; this diagnostic does not distinguish them. History compression in an external client is not observable here.
CoordinatorSettingsHelp: Main computer: model, API and node management. The local RPC port is unused. Disabled settings retain their values.
WorkerSettingsHelp: Network node: llama.cpp build, address and RPC port. The model and API run on the main computer; their settings are disabled and retained.
ModelEngineReadyHelp: llama-server: enabled after the model loads and inference API readiness is confirmed.
RpcEngineReadyHelp: ggml-rpc-server: enabled after the compute process starts and its local port is confirmed open.
MainAgentReadyHelp: Diagnostics and management for this computer. Its inference API does not require the local agent.
WorkerAgentReadyHelp: Connection to the main computer: node diagnostics and permitted RPC management.
ModelIdHelp: This llama-server API alias is open-llm-cluster. LM Studio model names, such as recursivesi/flint, belong to the LM Studio API and may differ. Use the ID advertised by the server your client connects to.
LocalModelHelp: On a worker, select the same GGUF as on the coordinator; for split models select the first part. Sizes and SHA-256 of every part are checked before startup. Large tensors are read from the local RPC cache. Preparation needs extra disk space comparable to the model size. Leave empty for normal network loading. Stop the agent and engine before changing the path.
LocalModelPathHint: Full path to a local GGUF on this computer
LocalModelNotConfigured: Local model is no longer configured on the node
LocalModelBuildRequired: Cache preparation is verified for build
GpuLayersHelp: -1: the engine fits layers and device placement to free memory with the configured device reserve. Saved tensor split applies only with an explicit layer count. Context and slots are preserved; auto does not guarantee capacity.
